days.title: Abbeys and Vineyards of Melk and Spitz
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Melk Abbey
stops.detail: Cultural highlights like castle ruins, Melk Abbey , and villages like Dürnstein and Weißenkirchen add to the area's calm, timeless appeal.

stops.name: Spitz an der Donau
stops.detail: A charming wine village, famous for the Tausendeimerberg, a steeply terraced vineyard.

days.title: Castles and Culture of Dürnstein and Krems
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Dürnstein
stops.detail: Renowned for the ruins of Dürnstein Castle, where Richard the Lionheart was hero captive in the Middle Ages.

stops.name: Weißenkirchen in der Wachau
stops.detail: A wine-growing centre surrounded by terraced vineyards and historic churches.

stops.name: Krems an der Donau
stops.detail: One of Austria’s oldest cities, with a vibrant cultural scene, including museums and festivals.

stops.name: Kunsthalle Krems
stops.detail: Highlights include the Danube Festival in Krems, the Glatt & Verkehrt Festival in Spitz, the Summer Plays in Melk, and the Kunsthalle Krems.
